title: Which Ukrainian city away from the eastern and southern front lines will experience repeated Russian strikes on fuel stations by September 11, 2026?
background: Russian attacks have repeatedly hit fuel stations near Ukraine’s eastern and southern battle lines. The spread of this targeting pattern to cities farther from the fighting would broaden its impact on civilians.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Ukrainian municipal statements and reliable contemporaneous reporting citing local authorities.
  • Resolution Conditions: Identify the Ukrainian city outside the eastern and southern frontline areas where Russian attacks are confirmed to have directly struck fuel stations on at least two separate days between September 1 and September 11, 2026. Reports of isolated attacks or incidental damage to nearby stations do not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the city.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: BBC Ukraine (Jul 14): the station campaign has spread to Sumy and Chernihiv oblasts and near Pyriatyn (Poltava oblast). HUR (Jul 17) says Russia ordered more strikes on gas stations in frontline and border areas, and Zhytomyr banned station operation during alerts. Recent hits were in Kharkiv (Jul 14) and Mykolaiv (Jul 20), both near-front cities.

title: Who will control Yemen's Mayun Island on September 11, 2026?
background: Mayun, also known as Perim, is an island in the Bab al-Mandeb Strait at the southern entrance to the Red Sea. Its location makes it strategically important for maritime traffic.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Contemporaneous reporting by The Associated Press or Al Jazeera identifying which military actor exercises territorial control over Mayun Island.
  • Resolution Date: Resolve according to confirmed control on September 11, 2026. Territorial control means physical possession of the island, not merely a sovereignty claim or the ability to threaten nearby shipping.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The commonly used name of the armed group, government, or coalition controlling the island.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: Saudi forces took Mayun from UAE-aligned forces in Jan 2026 (Al Arabiya). It is held under a joint Saudi-Yemeni command with a Saudi-funded coast guard. The July Houthi-Saudi escalation (naval embargo Jul 20, threats to close Bab el-Mandeb) adds some Houthi risk. The UAE was dropped.

title: Which U.S. player will advance furthest in men's singles at the 2026 US Open?
background: This question concerns the men's singles main draw, excluding qualifying.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official US Open results or reliable contemporaneous reporting of the 2026 tournament.
  • Resolution: Identify the player representing the United States with the highest tournament finish. The champion ranks above the runner-up, followed by semifinalists, quarterfinalists, and earlier-round finishers. Resolve once no remaining match can change the identity of the uniquely highest-finishing U.S. player.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The player's full name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: At Wimbledon, Fritz (6th seed) reached the QF and lost to finalist Zverev, while Shelton (4th seed) lost in R1 to qualifier Virtanen. Tien was seeded 16, Tiafoe 17 and Paul 21. The US Open draw is about Aug 27.

title: Who will win the men's 5,000 metres at the inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship in September 2026?
background: The inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship is scheduled to take place in Budapest in September 2026.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: World Athletics' official results or contemporaneous reporting from a reputable news organization.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the athlete declared the winner of the men's 5,000-metre final at the September 2026 World Athletics Ultimate Championship, once the final result is announced.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning athlete's full name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: Yihune won Xiamen (12:57.32) and Oslo (12:47.62 WL). Lobalu won Monaco (Jul 10) ahead of Blanks and Balew, and Balew was 2nd in Oslo with an Asian record. Hocker, the 2025 world champion, qualifies automatically. Ingebrigtsen had not raced in 2026 after Feb Achilles surgery (Irish Times, Jul 4), so he was dropped.

title: Who will receive the longest prison sentence at the trial over the July 2023 burglary of Gianluigi Donnarumma's Paris home?
background: Goalkeeper Gianluigi Donnarumma and his partner were attacked during a burglary at their Paris home in July 2023.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The Paris Criminal Court's judgment, as documented by the court or reliable contemporaneous reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Identify the defendant receiving the longest total prison sentence in the trial verdict delivered by September 30, 2026. Compare sentences actually imposed, including any suspended portions, rather than sentences requested by prosecutors. Later appeals do not affect resolution.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The defendant's name as publicly reported.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: AFP (Jul 11): the trial is set for Sep 10-11 at the Paris tribunal correctionnel with three adults: Kherbouch 'Ganito' (alleged main organizer, recidivist, escaped Villepinte in Mar 2026), co-organizer Khyan M. 'Kiki', and one executant (Bakary). Two minors were already sentenced in early July (4 and 3 years). Daril B. is not among the adult defendants.

last_rationale: sweep Jul21: Yan is unbeaten in 2026 with 4 Diamond League wins (71.74 Xiamen, 67.11 Oslo, 67.44 Paris, 68.75 Monaco on Jul 10), is world No. 1 and the only 70m+ thrower. Vilagos was 2nd in Monaco with 63.18. The UC field is 8. The risks are a skip for Asian Games prep or a bad day.

resolution_criteria:

Predictions (IONCINEMA Jul 18, Whitlock&Pope Jul 20) have Lee Chang-dong's Possible Love (TIFF North American premiere; IONCINEMA's Golden Lion pick), Herzog, Moretti, Amelio's Nessun dolore, Martone and Kore-eda. Italian films won this prize in 2019, 2021 and 2025. Re-forecast after the lineup.

title: Which country will Washington propose as a possible venue for renewed trilateral Russia–Ukraine ceasefire talks by September 25, 2026?
background: The United States has been involved in efforts to broker an end to the Russia–Ukraine war.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the country publicly identified by Ukraine's president as Washington's proposed location for renewed talks involving the United States, Russia and Ukraine, using the proposal current as of September 25, 2026. A suggested location is sufficient; the talks need not have taken place.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-09-25
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the country's common English name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: Talks stalled during the Iran war. In a Jul 4 call Trump offered to help, and Witkoff/Kushner may visit Moscow soon (RIA, Jul 8). At the Ankara NATO summit Trump asked Zelensky whether he would attend talks in Moscow. Earlier rounds were in Abu Dhabi and Geneva; Zelensky had said Switzerland or Turkiye, and the US floated Miami in Feb.

title: Which club will win the Manchester derby hosted by Manchester United in September 2026?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official match records, corroborated by contemporaneous match reports, for the September 2026 Manchester derby hosted by Manchester United.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the club with more goals in the official final score after the match, including stoppage time. If the scores are level, resolve to “Draw”.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning club's name, or “Draw” if neither club wins.

title: Who will win Okinawa's 2026 gubernatorial election?
background: Okinawa is Japan's southernmost prefecture, where the presence of US military bases is a major political issue.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official results announced by Okinawa's election authorities, either directly or as reported by reliable news organizations.
  • Resolution: The question resolves when the winner of Okinawa's 2026 gubernatorial election is officially announced.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning candidate's full name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: Former minister Mikio Shimoji entered on Jul 13, making it a three-way race. He accepts Henoko with changes and took 8% in 2022, so he mainly splits the conservative vote. Rengo recommended Tamaki on Jul 16, while the DPFP, the LDP and 10 of 11 city mayors back Koja (Jul 12-20). Now close to a toss-up.

background: The Spanish Grand Prix is a round of the Formula One World Championship.
resolution_criteria:

last_rationale: sweep Jul21: Antonelli won the Belgian GP on Jul 19, his 6th win in 10 rounds, and leads Hamilton by 45 points. Russell retired after a collision with Hamilton and has reported a 'mystery' car issue. Mercedes have won 8 of 10 races. Verstappen was on the front row at Spa and 2nd in Austria, so he replaces Norris in the list.

title: Which country will be the first in 2026 to publicly acknowledge deploying purpose-built weapons in Earth orbit?
background: Military satellites provide communications, navigation and intelligence services. Deploying weapons in orbit could significantly change how countries protect or threaten these systems.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Public statements by national governments or military officials, corroborated by reliable international news reporting.
  • Qualifying Event: Resolve to the country whose government or military first publicly acknowledges during 2026 that it has already deployed purpose-built weapons in Earth orbit. Merely describing satellites with potential military applications, announcing future deployments, or confirming ground-based anti-satellite weapons does not qualify.
  • Resolution Timing: Resolve on the date of the first qualifying public acknowledgment, provided it occurs by December 31, 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's commonly used English name.

title: Which city will be awarded hosting rights for the 2029 World Athletics Championships?
background: World Athletics selects the host cities for its biennial outdoor track-and-field world championships.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: World Athletics' official announcement awarding hosting rights for the 2029 World Athletics Championships.
  • Resolution: Resolve when World Athletics first publicly announces the successful host city. The initial award determines the answer, regardless of any subsequent changes.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Provide the name of the selected city, not the country or stadium.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: India's bid city is Ahmedabad, not New Delhi. The AFI chief (Jun 27) named London, Munich and Kenya as the main rivals and said the decision comes at a meeting after the Budapest Ultimate Championships (Sep 11-13). London's 2029 bid has GLA and government funding (~GBP 43m, Jun 17) but still faces West Ham's refusal to free the stadium in September. Munich has no venue conflict and is bidding for 2029 or 2031.

title: Which country will privately ask Iran to help rein in Yemen's Houthis following an appeal from Saudi Arabia by September 17, 2026?
background: The Houthis are an Iran-aligned armed movement in Yemen.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Reuters reporting between August 1 and September 17, 2026, identifying the country that privately asked Iranian officials to help restrain the Houthis after receiving a Saudi appeal over Houthi attacks.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-09-17
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the country's common English name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: Reuters (Jul 17): after the Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia on Jul 13, Pakistan told Iran it would treat attacks on the kingdom as attacks on itself. Pakistan and Qatar are the main US-Iran intermediaries, and the Houthis declared a Saudi naval blockade on Jul 20. China has a precedent (Reuters, Jan 2024, pressing Iran to 'rein in' the Houthis) and Oman leads Saudi-Houthi mediation.

title: Which country will be the focus of a joint appeal to leaders at the September 2026 UN General Assembly to safeguard humanitarian aid and support a nationally led peace process?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the country targeted by the September 2026 appeal from international humanitarian, development and civil society organisations calling on UN General Assembly leaders to protect humanitarian aid delivery, maintain essential services and support a nationally led peace process. Use the organisations' public statement or contemporaneous Al Jazeera reporting.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-09-23
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the country's common English name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: The Houthi-Saudi truce collapsed: Houthi missiles hit Abha on Jul 13 and the Houthis declared a naval blockade of Saudi Arabia on Jul 20. That raises Yemen's profile ahead of UNGA81. Joint NGO statements on Yemen at UNGA precede this (2023; Sept 23, 2025), with asks matching protecting aid, essential services and a Yemeni-led peace process. Sudan is the main alternative.

title: Which official will Nigeria's interior minister suspend over the deaths of detained miners in Niger State in September 2026?
background: Nigerian authorities have announced that miners died while being held in custody in Niger State.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Statements from Nigeria's Interior Ministry or reliable news reporting of the ministry's disciplinary decisions.
  • Resolution: Identify the official suspended by the interior minister in connection with the miners' deaths in custody in Niger State. The suspension must be publicly announced by 30 September 2026; calls for disciplinary action without an announced suspension do not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The suspended official's full name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: Reports from Jan-May 2026 confirm Suberu Siyaka Aniviye is the NSCDC Niger State commandant. The NSCDC is under the interior ministry and leads anti-illegal-mining enforcement there. A Jul 2026 case (a miner died after a military arrest in Suleja) shows the risk, but no custody-death suspension has been announced yet.

title: Which sector will show the largest year-on-year percentage decline in Iran's official GDP report for March 21–June 20, 2026?
background: Iran is at war with the United States and Israel.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Statistical Center of Iran's GDP figures for March 21–June 20, 2026, publicly reported by September 21, 2026. The answer is the economic sector with the greatest year-on-year percentage contraction among the sectors reported.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-09-21
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the sector's conventional name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: SCI's 1404 annual report (Jun 22) gave sub-sector figures (oil & gas +1.8%, manufacturing -1.5%, water/electricity -6.5%, construction +1.4%, agriculture -2.9%), so resolution may use sub-sectors. SCI also groups oil inside 'industries and mines'. The Apr-Jun 2026 US blockade hit oil exports in spring 1405, so Oil stays the favourite.
